'''Ginger group''' was a group of three [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They were involved in the [[Recapture of Outpost D-34|Second Battle of Javin]]. They were launched from the recently captured [[Outpost D-34]] platform. They attacked the [[Frigate/Legends|Frigate]] ''[[Fogger]]'' but all three were destroyed.
